subject: general
question: What is the main purpose of a bank statement?

options.text: To transfer funds to another account
To have locker facility in the bank

solution:
The correct answer is __**To track income and expenses**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main purpose of a **bank statement **is **to track income and expenses**.
 
• A bank statement is a **summary of financial transactions **that have occurred over a given period on a bank account.
 
• It helps account holders to understand their spending habits, monitor for any unauthorized transactions, and manage their finances effectively.
 
• Bank statements typically include **deposits, withdrawals, checks paid, interest earned**, and any fees or charges incurred.
 
• Regularly reviewing bank statements can help in budgeting and financial planning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bank statements can be received in paper form by mail or accessed electronically through online banking.
 
• They are typically issued monthly, though some banks may offer quarterly or even daily statements.
 
• It is important to review your bank statement for any discrepancies and report them to the bank promptly.
 
• Some banks also provide categorized summaries of spending to help customers better understand their financial behavior.
